status_values.cited: stated in the method paper, docs or code at the given line
status_values.inferred_from_code: follows from the cited code, not stated in words
status_values.约定: 约定，未经推演: not found in the method sources; basis given

canonical_frame: project motion.npz: right-handed Z-up, metres; native Y-up maps (x, y, z) -> (x, -z, y) (utils/motiogen/motion.py:17-18,55-61, applied in utils/motiogen/adapters.py:80-81)
paths: baselines/... are relative to the data root (config/baselines.json data_root); other paths are repository paths

up_axis.basis: baselines/PRIMAL/README.md:86 "PRIMAL uses the Y-up world coordinate"

forward_axis.basis: baselines/PRIMAL/primal/utils/mop_repr.py:272-278: x = left_hip - right_hip with y zeroed, y up, z = x cross y, so the first frame faces +Z

units.basis: control speeds in m/s (baselines/PRIMAL/scripts/run_principledControl.sh:81); SMPL-X body model in metres

floor.definition: ground_snap=1: the lowest FK joint is placed at y = 0.01 m on the plane y = 0; ground_snap=0 declares no floor (not in any scored set)
floor.basis: baselines/PRIMAL/primal/models/motion_diffuser.py:721-722 ("ground plane (y=0.01)"), 533-554, 971-986; eval_metrics.py:180-182 "Assuming the ground plane is XZ=0"
